name: @weavetab/plugin-realtime
description: Causal age/proximity tags for browser_map, 60Hz in-page reflex rules, canvas entity sampling and a bounded click loop.

cdp.reason: Installs the in-page MutationObserver, hooks Canvas2D/rAF, and dispatches click/key events.

tools.reason: Registers realtime_canvas, realtime_reflex, realtime_autopilot, and realtime_status.

commands.reason: Registers status and reflex-clear CLI commands.

hooks.reason: Arms the in-page mutation probe before actions and tags newly added nodes in browser_map output.

network.reason: Allows realtime_autopilot to query an optional local OpenAI-compatible model endpoint.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Read the in-page realtime probe state, canvas frame counter, and active 60Hz reflex rules.

options.name: wait_ms
options.description: Block up to wait_ms until active reflexes finish

commands.name: reflex-clear
commands.description: Clear all active 60Hz reflex rules on the active browser tab via CLI.

commands.name: autopilot
commands.description: Run bounded in-page autopilot toward a goal directly via CLI.

prompts.name: realtime_watch
prompts.description: Snapshot live DOM mutations, active reflexes, and Canvas2D entities, then guide the agent to wire a 60Hz reflex rule.

arguments.name: goal
arguments.description: What the reflex should watch for and do

resources.name: realtime_canvas_feed
resources.description: Live snapshot of Canvas2D draw counts, rAF frame rate, and active moving entity bounding boxes.

resources.name: realtime_feed
resources.description: Live snapshot of newly mutated DOM elements (with click distance), active 60Hz reflex rules, and tracked Canvas2D entities.

tools.name: realtime_canvas
tools.description: Records Canvas2D draw calls across requestAnimationFrame ticks and returns moving/static entities with bounding boxes and px/frame velocity.

tools.name: realtime_reflex
tools.description: Registers, removes, lists, or clears in-page 60Hz requestAnimationFrame rules that click or press keys on DOM or Canvas2D triggers without an LLM round-trip.

when.description: DOM selector or Canvas2D expression trigger

stop_selector.description: Selector that halts the rule when present

tools.name: realtime_autopilot
tools.description: Runs a bounded in-page click loop toward a short goal ('accept cookies', 'continue') with causal age/dialog scoring and optional local model pick.

stop_when_text.description: Stop when body text contains string

tools.name: realtime_status
tools.description: Returns the live state of the in-page probe, Canvas2D spy, and active 60Hz reflex rules. Optionally waits until reflexes complete.

wait_ms.description: Wait up to wait_ms (max 30000) for active reflexes to finish
